Product.title: Product
Product.description: An affiliate marketing product listing with link, image, price, and category properties.

title.description: The title of the product listing.

description.description: Full-text description detailing features, benefits, and specifications.

shortDescription.description: A high-impact short description for visual product cards.

imageUrl.description: Secure URL pointing to the product asset image.

affiliateUrl.description: Our referral URL for redirecting client purchase intents.

category.description: Category categorization label, e.g., Tech, Gadgets, Software, Deals.

price.description: Current price of the product shown in the interface.

originalPrice.description: Original retail price shown before discount as cross-out text.

benefits.description: A bounded array listing user benefit strings.

images.description: An array of alternative product showcase image asset URLs.

rating.description: Weighted satisfaction rating scale, from 1.0 to 5.0.

isFeatured.description: Indicates whether the product represents a high-profile home screen hero.

isTrending.description: Indicates whether the product displays in the trending carousels.

secureCheckoutDetails.description: Customizable secure checkout pipeline detail text displayed in product modal.

trustTitle.description: Customizable title for the checkout trust badges panel.

trustDesc.description: Customizable description for the checkout trust badges panel.

clickCount.description: Statistical summary count tracking redirected checkouts.

ClickEvent.title: ClickEvent
ClickEvent.description: An interaction telemetry event tracing affiliate outbound redirection click metadata.

productId.description: Unique identifier linking this event back to the original source Product.

productTitle.description: Human-readable label capturing the product title at click-time.

referrer.description: Web navigation source context matching referrer.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: A restricted user registration designating official platform administrative credentials.

email.description: Identified safe email address for administrative checks.

SystemConfig.title: SystemConfig
SystemConfig.description: General system configuration document or custom page content (About Us, Contact, Privacy).

content.description: The text or markdown content of the page.

email.description: Main contact email address (optional, for Contact page).

phone.description: Main contact phone number (optional, for Contact page).

address.description: Contact physical location address (optional, for Contact page).

updatedAt.description: Page or config last update timestamp.

ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: A user-submitted contact inquiry message sent through the web storefront Contact form.

message.description: The raw text message describing their inquiry or interest.

/clickEvents/{eventId}.description: Event telemetry logs for product affiliate link redirection clicks.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Explicitly defined whitelist record verifying administrative auth tokens.

/configs/{configId}.description: Site-wide customizable configurations, layout parameters, or dynamic rich pages like About, Contact, or Privacy.

/contactMessages/{messageId}.description: Guest and user-submitted contact message inquiries.

/visitorSessions/{sessionId}.description: Live sessions for real-time visitor counts and device analytics.
